fact: General Packaging Corporation opened for business in 1957, was incorporated 8/25/1960, and has been BBB accredited since 4/3/2006 — placing it at 68–69 years in business as of mid-2026 (BBB currently lists 'Years in Business: 69').

James W. Brown III (President), James Brown IV (Executive Vice President), and Bradley E. Brown (Director) are listed as current leaders of General Packaging Corporation on the live BBB profile. James Brown IV is the grandson of the founder (James William Brown, who passed in 2017), making this a three-generation family-owned and operated business. ThomasNet independently corroborates all three Browns as owners.

Located just to the north of Houston in Conroe, TX, this plant serves the greater Houston metroplex and surrounding areas. General Packaging Corp. has been selling quality industrial packaging to the Houston market for decades and this plant specializes in the industrial packaging needs of this unique market, with a special focus on oil & gas, heavy industry and export business packaging requirements.

A heavy-duty, double-wall corrugated container with integrated foam cushioning and a built-in loading ramp, purpose-built for simplified equipment handling — developed as a cost-effective alternative to a traditional plywood crate, driving reductions in both material cost and freight weight without compromising performance. Featured in the 'Featured Projects' section of the current homepage at gpctexas.com.

General Packaging Corporation's homepage features a project in which they designed a sturdy wooden crate reinforced with wood/foam inserts, adjustable interior compartments to accommodate different motor sizes and shapes, and robust latches for easy access and resealing — enabling reuse across multiple shipments.

General Packaging Corporation holds an active USDOT carrier record (USDOT #1266901), reporting 8 drivers and 9 power units, based in Richardson, TX. The FMCSA SMS record was current as of April 4, 2026, and dot.report data was timestamped January 21, 2026.

The Dallas Plant is a wood products manufacturing facility that specializes in new construction wood pallets, crates, bed frame foundations and many other custom wood products. It has been a mainstay in the Fair Park area since 1981. (Source: https://gpctexas.com/locations/, dated March 20, 2025; corroborated by https://www.gpctexas.com/pallet-products.html, dated May 20, 2026.)
We also collect and sell back wood waste to sawmills or farmers for their livestock.
